ValidationRule.description: Date fields cannot be earlier than coupon created date and must be equal or later than today
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR ( ISCHANGED( Coupon_Distributed_Date__c ) && ( Coupon_Distributed_Date__c > TODAY() || Coupon_Distributed_Date__c < DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) ), ISCHANGED( Coupon_Issued_Date__c ) && ( Coupon_Issued_Date__c > TODAY() || Coupon_Issued_Date__c < DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) ), ISCHANGED( Coupon_Issued_but_Voided_Date__c ) && ( Coupon_Issued_but_Voided_Date__c > TODAY() || Coupon_Issued_but_Voided_Date__c < DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) ), ISCHANGED( Coupon_Unissued_but_Voided_Date__c ) && ( Coupon_Unissued_but_Voided_Date__c > TODAY() || Coupon_Unissued_but_Voided_Date__c < DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) ), ISCHANGED( Coupon_Used_Date__c ) && ( Coupon_Used_Date__c > TODAY() || Coupon_Used_Date__c < DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please ensure that the date value entered is not earlier than the coupon created date or later than today's date
